Ketika ada di medan perang sebagai prajurit bayaran, dia bersikeras untuk memakai zirah yang paling mewah, akhirnya dia membuat zirah itu sendiri. Keindahan dari hiasan dari helmnya membuatnya terkenal sebagai ahli besi, dia mendapat pelanggan dari keluarga ningrat, seperti ksatria, dan bahkan sang kaisar sendiri. Tapi, pada saat ini, dia ingin dikenal karena keahliannya sebagai prajurit, dan katanya dia menolak untuk melayani permintaan sang kaisar untuk alasan ini.
raw.pt: Um ferreiro especializado em elmos e soldado feiticeiro. Quando colocado em batalha como mercenário ele insistiu em usar a armadura mais extravagante, começando a fazê-la por conta própria. A beleza dos adornos delicados de seu elmo fizeram sua fama como ferreiro, conseguindo clientes de famílias nobres, como cavaleiros, e até o próprio imperador. No entanto, nessa época ele desejava ser reconhecido somente por suas habilidades como soldado, então dizem que ele recusou o pedido do imperador por seus serviços por esse motivo.
raw.th: ช่างตีเหล็กผู้เชียวชาญเรื่องหมวกเกราะและทหารผู้ใช้เวทมนตร์ที่โด่งดั เมื่ออยู่ในสนามรบในฐานะทหารรับจ้าง, เขายืนยันที่จะมีเกราะหรูหรามากที่สุด, จนในที่สุดเขาก็เริ่มสร้างมันด้วยตัวเอง ความงามของเครื่องประดับที่ละเอียดอ่อนบนหมวกของเขาทำให้เขาได้รับชื่อเสียงในฐานะช่างตีเหล็ก, จูงใจลูกค้าจากครอบครัวอันสูงส่งเช่นอัศวินและแม้แต่จักรพรรดิตัวเอง อย่างไรก็ตาม ณเวลาที่จุดนี้ เขาหวังว่าจะเป็นที่รู้จักจากทักษะในฐานะทหารเท่านั้น,และลือกันว่าเขาปฏิเสธคำขอของจักรพรรดิไปด้วยเหตุผลนี้
raw.vi: Một thợ rèn chuyên chế tạo mũ và một chiến binh biết sử dụng ma thuật lừng danh. Khi được đưa ra chiến trường như một lính đánh thuê, anh nhất thiết phải có bộ giáp lộng lẫy nhất, cuối cùng đã tự bắt tay làm nó. Vẻ đẹp của những hoa văn tinh tế trên mũ mang lại danh tiếng cho anh với tư cách là một thợ rèn, mang đến các khách hàng từ các gia đình quý tộc, như các hiệp sĩ và thậm chí cả bản thân hoàng đế. Tuy nhiên, vào thời gian này anh chỉ muốn được công nhận bởi những kỹ năng của mình như một chiến binh và có tin đồn rằng anh đã từ chối yêu cầu phục vụ của hoàng đế chính vì lý do này.

id: Ahli pembuat helm yang paling terkenal dan dipuja di sejarah Agni. Ketika perang dengan para dewa dimulai, sisi prajuritnya dan sisi ahli besinya mulai bersatu. Seiring dengan perngalaman yang didapatkannya di medan perang, dia menggunakan sihir apinya untuk meningggalkan banyak karya hebat sebagai pusakanya. Tapi, benda yang paling dibanggakannya selalu disimpannya untuk diri sendiri. Katanya ketika Vanberk memakai zirah terbaiknya, dia tidak mungkin kalah di medan perang.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_10585_DESCRIPTION
desc: The most renowned and praised helmet smith in Agni history. When the war with the gods began, his soldier side and his blacksmith side finally started unifying. Along with the experience he had gained on the battlefield, he put his fire magic to use in order to leave behind countless masterpieces as his legacy. However, the pieces he was most proud of he would always keep for himself. It is said that when Vanberk was clad in his best armor, he was impossible to take down in the battlefield.

raw.en: The most renowned and praised helmet smith in Agni history. When the war with the gods began, his soldier side and his blacksmith side finally started unifying. Along with the experience he had gained on the battlefield, he put his fire magic to use in order to leave behind countless masterpieces as his legacy. However, the pieces he was most proud of he would always keep for himself. It is said that when Vanberk was clad in his best armor, he was impossible to take down in the battlefield.
raw.es: El más alabado y reconocido forjador de yelmos en la historia de Agní. Cuando comenzó la guerra contra los dioses, su lado de herrero y su lado de soldado finalmente comenzaron a unirse. Junto con la experiencia que había obtenido en el campo de batalla, Vanberk utilizó su magia ígnea para dejar como legado incontables obras maestras. Sin embargo, siempre se quedaba con las piezas que más le enorgullecían. Se dice que cuando Vanberk se cubría con su mejor armadura, era imposible que lo derribaran en batalla.
raw.id: Ahli pembuat helm yang paling terkenal dan dipuja di sejarah Agni. Ketika perang dengan para dewa dimulai, sisi prajuritnya dan sisi ahli besinya mulai bersatu. Seiring dengan perngalaman yang didapatkannya di medan perang, dia menggunakan sihir apinya untuk meningggalkan banyak karya hebat sebagai pusakanya. Tapi, benda yang paling dibanggakannya selalu disimpannya untuk diri sendiri. Katanya ketika Vanberk memakai zirah terbaiknya, dia tidak mungkin kalah di medan perang.
raw.pt: O fabricante de elmos mais famoso e adorado na história de Agni. Quando a guerra contra os deuses começou, seu lado soldado e seu lado ferreiro finalmente começaram a se unir. Junto com a experiência que ele adquiriu em batalha, ele usou sua magia de fogo para deixar inúmeras obras-primas como legado. No entanto, as peças de que ele mais se orgulhava ficavam para si mesmo. Dizem que, quando Vanberk forjou sua melhor armadura, ninguém conseguia derrubá-lo em batalha.
raw.th: ช่างทำหมวกเกราะที่โด่งดังและถูกยกย่องมากที่สุดในประวัติศาสตร์แอ็กนี่ เมื่อสงครามกับเทพเจ้าเริ่มต้นขึ้น, ด้านทหารกับด้านช่างตีเหล็กของเขาก็เริ่มรวมเข้าด้วยกันในที่สุด พร้อมด้วยประสบการณ์ที่เขาได้รับมาจากสนามรบ, เขาได้ใช้เวทย์ไฟของเขาเพื่อทิ้งมรดกผลงานชิ้นโบว์แดงเอาไว้นับไม่ถ้วน อย่างไรก็ตาม, ชิ้นที่เขาภาคภูมิใจมากที่สุด เขาจะเก็บมันไว้สำหรับตนเองเสมอ ว่ากันว่า เมื่อแวนเบิร์คถูกคุ้มกันด้วยเกราะที่ดีที่สุดของเขา ก็เป็นไปไม่ได้เลยที่จะล้มเขาในสนามรบ
raw.vi: Thợ rèn mũ nổi tiếng và được ca ngợi nhất trong lịch sử Agni. Khi chiến tranh với các vị thần bắt đầu, mặt chiến binh và mặt thợ rèn trong anh cuối cùng đã bắt đầu hợp nhất. Cùng với kinh nghiệm anh có được trên chiến trường, anh đã đưa vào sử dụng phép thuật lửa của mình để để lại vô số những kiệt tác như di sản của mình. Tuy nhiên, kiệt tác mà anh tự hào nhất anh luôn giữ cho riêng mình. Tương tuyền rằng khi Vanberk mặc bộ giáp tốt nhất của mình, anh trở nên không thể hạ gục trên chiến trường.

id: Murid yang dulu melayani Zevalhua Supremasi. Dia dikenal sangat percaya pada kekuatan. Katanya dia menganggap remeh Mare, murid lain dari Zevalhua. Mengklaim bahwa kelemahan adalah kejahatan, banyak cerita yang menuduhnya membuat onar karena kepercayaannya ini. Tapi, Zevalhua menyukai sikapnya ini, dan tidak pernah menghukumnya karena perbuatannya. Informasi lebih lanjut tentang murid ini tidak tersedia sebelum perang besar melawan para dewa.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_10594_DESCRIPTION
desc: A disciple who once served Zevalhua the Supreme. He was known for his firm believe in power. It is believed he thought very little of Mare, another of Zevalhua's disciples. Claiming that weakness was evil, many stories left behind accuse him of causing problems on account of his beliefs. However, Zevalhua enjoyed his particular attitude, and never punished him for his actions. Any further information on this disciple became unavailable long before the great war against the gods.

raw.en: A disciple who once served Zevalhua the Supreme. He was known for his firm believe in power. It is believed he thought very little of Mare, another of Zevalhua's disciples. Claiming that weakness was evil, many stories left behind accuse him of causing problems on account of his beliefs. However, Zevalhua enjoyed his particular attitude, and never punished him for his actions. Any further information on this disciple became unavailable long before the great war against the gods.
raw.es: Un discípulo que sirvió a Zevalhua, la Suprema. Se lo conocía por su ferviente anhelo de poder. Se cree que subestimaba a Mare, otra discípula de Zevalhua. En muchas historias se lo acusa de causar problemas por sus credos, ya que aseguraba que la debilidad era signo de malicia. Sin embargo, a Zevalhua le gustaba esa actitud y nunca lo castigó por su comportamiento. La información sobre este discípulo se perdió mucho antes de la gran guerra contra los dioses.
raw.id: Murid yang dulu melayani Zevalhua Supremasi. Dia dikenal sangat percaya pada kekuatan. Katanya dia menganggap remeh Mare, murid lain dari Zevalhua. Mengklaim bahwa kelemahan adalah kejahatan, banyak cerita yang menuduhnya membuat onar karena kepercayaannya ini. Tapi, Zevalhua menyukai sikapnya ini, dan tidak pernah menghukumnya karena perbuatannya. Informasi lebih lanjut tentang murid ini tidak tersedia sebelum perang besar melawan para dewa.
raw.pt: Um discípulo que serviu a Zevalhua, a Suprema. Ele era conhecido por sua crença no poder. Acredita-se que ele não se importava muito com Mare, outro discípulo de Zevalhua. Afirmando que a fraqueza era maligna, muitas histórias do passado o acusam de causar problemas por suas crenças. Mas Zevalhua aprovou suas atitudes e jamais o puniu por suas ações. Outras informações sobre este discípulo tornaram-se indisponíveis muito antes da grande guerra contra os deuses.
raw.th: สาวกที่เคยรับใช้เซวาลฮัวผุ้ยิ่งใหญ่ เขาเป็นที่รู้จักกันดีจากนิสัยความเชื่อมั่นอย่างแรงกล้าในพลัง เชื่อกันว่าเขาไม่เห็น แมร์ สาวกอีกตนหนึ่งของเซวาลฮัวอยู่ในสายตา อ้างว่าความอ่อนแอนั้นคือความชั่วร้าย หลายๆ เรื่องราวที่ถูกทิ้งไว้ กล่าวหาเขาว่าสร้างปัญหาจากความเชื่อของเขา อย่างไรก็ตาม, เซวาลฮัวชื่นชอบในนิสัยดังกล่าวและไม่ไม่เคยลงโทษเขาจากการกระทำเหล่านั้น ข้อมูลอื่นๆ เกี่ยวกับสาวกผุ้นี้ไม่มีมานานนับตั้งแต่ก่อนสงครามครั้งใหญ่กับเทพเจ้าจะเริ่มขึ้นเสียอีก
raw.vi: Một đệ tử từng phục vụ Đấng Tối Cao Zevalhua. Anh nổi tiếng vì niềm tin kiên định vào sức mạnh. Anh được cho là rất ít nghĩ về Mare, một đệ tử khác của Zevalhua. Tuyên bố rằng yếu đuối là tội lỗi, nhiều câu chuyện đằng sau buộc tội anh gây ra rắc rối vì niềm tin của anh. Tuy nhiên, Zevalhua có quan điểm riêng và không bao giờ trừng phạt anh vì những hành động của anh. Không có thêm bất kỳ thông tin nào về đệ tử này rất lâu trước cuộc đại chiến với các vị thần.

id: Bekas murid dari Zevalhua Supremasi. Mengklaim kekuatan adalah segalanya, katanya Alpha menantang ratunya Zevalhua untuk mengetes kekuatannya. Ini adalah pertama kali dia menyadari kesenangan yang diperoleh memberikan segalanya dalam medan perang. Tapi, pertarungan itu terganggu oleh salah satu trik Mare, memaksa Alpha berhenti setelah mengalami luka parah. Setelah perang itu, dia menerima bantuan dari dewa berpangkat lebih tinggi yang menawarinya penghalang agar dia bisa tidur selama lukanya berangsur sembuh.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_10595_DESCRIPTION
desc: A former disciple of Zevalhua the Supreme. Claiming power to be everything, it is said that Alpha challenged his mistress Zevalhua to test her power. This was the first time he came to understand the delight of giving one's all on the battlefield.  However, the battle was interrupted thanks to one of Mare's tricks, forcing Alpha to retire after suffering a serious wound. Following the battle he received aid from a higher ranking god who offered him a barrier to slumber in while his wounds healed.

raw.en: A former disciple of Zevalhua the Supreme. Claiming power to be everything, it is said that Alpha challenged his mistress Zevalhua to test her power. This was the first time he came to understand the delight of giving one's all on the battlefield.  However, the battle was interrupted thanks to one of Mare's tricks, forcing Alpha to retire after suffering a serious wound. Following the battle he received aid from a higher ranking god who offered him a barrier to slumber in while his wounds healed.
raw.es: Un antiguo discípulo de Zevalhua, la Suprema. Se dice que Alfa desafió a la dama Zevalhua a probar su poder porque aseguraba que la fuerza lo era todo. Esa fue la vez que comprendió el placer de dejar el alma en cada batalla.  Sin embargo, la lucha se truncó gracias a una de las tretas de Mare y Alfa tuvo que retirarse tras ser herido de gravedad. Tras la batalla recibió ayuda de un dios de alto rango que le ofreció ingresar a una barrera y dormir mientras sus heridas sanaban.
raw.id: Bekas murid dari Zevalhua Supremasi. Mengklaim kekuatan adalah segalanya, katanya Alpha menantang ratunya Zevalhua untuk mengetes kekuatannya. Ini adalah pertama kali dia menyadari kesenangan yang diperoleh memberikan segalanya dalam medan perang. Tapi, pertarungan itu terganggu oleh salah satu trik Mare, memaksa Alpha berhenti setelah mengalami luka parah. Setelah perang itu, dia menerima bantuan dari dewa berpangkat lebih tinggi yang menawarinya penghalang agar dia bisa tidur selama lukanya berangsur sembuh.
raw.pt: Um antigo discípulo de Zevalhua, a Suprema. Afirmando que poder era tudo, dizem que Alpha desafiou Zevalhua para testar seus poderes. Foi quando ele entendeu a alegria de dar tudo de si na batalha.  Mas a batalha foi interrompida, graças a um truque de Mare, que feriu Alpha seriamente. Após a batalha ele recebeu a ajuda de um grande deus, que ofereceu algo para ele hibernar enquanto se curava.
raw.th: อดีตสาวกของเซวาลฮัวผู้ยิ่งใหญ่ อ้างว่าพลังคือทุกสิ่งทุกอย่าง, ว่ากันว่าอัลฟ่าไดเท้าทายนายหญิงของเขา เซวาลฮัวเพื่อทดสอบพลังของเธอ นี่เป็นครั้งแรกที่เขาได้เข้าใจความยินดีของการทุ่มสุดตัวในสนามรบ อย่างไรก็ตาม, การต่อสู้ถูกหยุดลงเพราะแผนการของแมร์, ทำให้อัลฟ่าต้องหยุดลงหลังจากบาดเจ็บสาหัส หลังจากการต่อสู้เขาได้รับการช่วยเหลือจากเทพเจ้าระดับสูงกว่าผู้เสนอม่านพลังให้เขาหลับพักผ่อนขณะที่แผลของเขากำลังเยียวยา
raw.vi: Một đệ tử cũ của Đấng Tối Cao Zevalhua. Tuyên bố sức mạnh là tất cả, tương truyền rằng Alpha đã thách đấu với nữ chủ nhân của mình Zevalhua để thử sức mạnh của bà. Đây là lần đầu tiên anh hiểu được niềm vui của việc cho ai đó tất cả trên chiến trường.  Tuy nhiên, trận chiến đã bị gián đoạn nhờ một trong các mưu mẹo của Mare, buộc Alpha phải rút lui sau khi bị thương nặng. Sau trận chiến, anh đã nhận được sự trợ giúp của một vị thần thứ hạng cao hơn, vị thần này đã tạo ra cho anh một rào cản bảo vệ để anh có thể ngủ trong khi vết thương lành lại.

id: Bekas murid dari Zevalhua yang disegel di Ishgria. Meskipun Alpha ditawari penghalang untuk tidur demi menyembuhkan luka-lukanya, ini sebenarnya adalah perangkap untuk menyegelnya. Tapi, dia diberi tahu oleh penangkapnya bahwa murid yang dikenal sebagai Enam Pilar akan bertarung satu sama lain, memberi pemenangnya lebih banyak kekuatan. Dan karena itu, Alpha memasuki kompetisi dengan penuh semangat, mengeluarkan semua kekuatannya dalam pertarungan. Meskipun tanpa dia ketahui, ini adalah siasat agar para murid saling menghancurkan.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_10596_DESCRIPTION
desc: A former disciple of Zevalhua who was sealed in Ishgria. Though Alpha had been offered a barrier in which to slumber in order to heal his wounds, this was actually a trap to seal him away. However, he was told by his captor that the disciples known as the Six Pillars were to battle each other, rewarding the victor with more power. And thus, Alpha entered the competition in high spirits, releasing the true extent of his power as he fought. Although unbeknownst to him, apparently this was all a ploy to lead the disciples to destroy one another.

raw.en: A former disciple of Zevalhua who was sealed in Ishgria. Though Alpha had been offered a barrier in which to slumber in order to heal his wounds, this was actually a trap to seal him away. However, he was told by his captor that the disciples known as the Six Pillars were to battle each other, rewarding the victor with more power. And thus, Alpha entered the competition in high spirits, releasing the true extent of his power as he fought. Although unbeknownst to him, apparently this was all a ploy to lead the disciples to destroy one another.
raw.es: Un discípulo de Zevalhua, la Suprema, que terminó encerrado en Ishgria. A Alfa le ofrecieron ingresar a una barrera para descansar y esperar a que sanaran sus heridas. El discípulo no sabía que era una trampa. Su captor le contó que los discípulos conocidos como los Seis Pilares estaban luchando entre sí, y el ganador recibiría más poder. Por ende, Alfa ingresó a la competencia con mucho brío y desató su verdadero poder mientras luchaba. Sin embargo, había algo que su captor le había ocultado: el plan era que los discípulos se mataran entre sí.
raw.id: Bekas murid dari Zevalhua yang disegel di Ishgria. Meskipun Alpha ditawari penghalang untuk tidur demi menyembuhkan luka-lukanya, ini sebenarnya adalah perangkap untuk menyegelnya. Tapi, dia diberi tahu oleh penangkapnya bahwa murid yang dikenal sebagai Enam Pilar akan bertarung satu sama lain, memberi pemenangnya lebih banyak kekuatan. Dan karena itu, Alpha memasuki kompetisi dengan penuh semangat, mengeluarkan semua kekuatannya dalam pertarungan. Meskipun tanpa dia ketahui, ini adalah siasat agar para murid saling menghancurkan.
raw.pt: Um antigo discípulo de Zevalhua que foi trancado em Ishgria. Embora Alpha tenha recebido algo para hibernar enquanto se curava, na verdade era uma armadilha para aprisioná-lo. Porém, seu capturador disse que os discípulos, os chamados Seis Pilares, deveriam lutar entre si, e o vitorioso ganharia mais poder. E assim, Alpha entrou na competição com motivação, revelando a verdadeira extensão de seus poderes ao lutar. Embora sem seu conhecimento, isso era apenas um plano para que os discípulos destruíssem uns aos outros.
raw.th: อดีตสาวกของเซวาลฮัวผู้ถูกผนึกในอิชเกรีย แม้ว่าอัลฟ่าจะได้รับข้อเสนอความคุ้มครองในขณะหลับพักผ่อนเพื่อที่จะรักษาแผลของเขา, แท้ที่จริงแล้วนี่คือกับดักเพื่อผนึกเขาทิ้ง อย่างไรก็ตาม, ผู้ที่จับเขาได้บอกว่าสาวกที่รู้จักในนาม เสาทั้งหกนั้นจะต้องต่อสู้กันเอง, รางวัลของผู้ชนะก็คือพลังที่เพิ่มมากขึ้น และดังนั้น, อัลฟ่าจึงเข้าร่วมแข่งขันด้วยจิตใจแรงกล้า, ปลดปล่อยขอบเขตที่แท้จริงของพลังของเขาขณะต่อสู้ แม้ว่าเขาจะไม่รู้เลย, ดูเหมือนว่าทั้งหมดนี่เป็นแผนเพื่อให้เหล่าสาวกนั้นทำลายกันเอง
raw.vi: Một đệ tử cũ của Zevalhua đã bị phong ấn tại Ishgria. Mặc dù Alpha đã được cung cấp một rào chắn bảo vệ để có thể chợp mắt và chữa lành vết thương, nhưng đây thực ra là một cái bẫy phong ấn anh lại. Tuy nhiên, người bắt giam anh đã nói với anh rằng các đệ tử được gọi là Sáu Trụ Cột sẽ chiến đấu với nhau và người chiến thắng sẽ được thưởng thêm sức mạnh. Và do đó, Alpha rất phấn khích tham gia vào cuộc thi, giải phóng hết khả năng sức mạnh thực sự của mình khi anh chiến đấu. Mặc dù anh không biết, nhưng rõ ràng đây hoàn toàn là một thủ đoạn để khiến các đệ tử đi đến hủy diệt lẫn nhau.

id: One of the sacred Guardians of Meirith, who worshipped the Holy Emperor Karna Masta in the La Veda Republic. Born the daughter of a priest from the Great Holy Shrine, she later became a knight until her and her younger twin brother were ordered to serve as Guardians. Surpassing every quality expected of a warrior, including heart, technique, and physique, she was admired by many. However, there are those who claim she turned into a completely different person on the battlefield, turning into an almost demonic creature when infuriated, and sprouting the rumor that something violent lived within her. On the other hand, she is said to have been overprotective of her younger brother as well.

id: One of the sacred Guardians of Meirith. When Grand Gaia found itself threatened by demon attacks, the Holy Emperor bestowed a pike of flame upon her, subsequently joining forces with other Guardians to visit territories that had been sealed away. It is said that it was there where she performed a feat that surpassed the gods' expectations. Legend has it that a group of gods thought her rapidly growing power a menace, as it almost surpassed those of regular disciples, and thus sent her off on a demon slaying mission they predicted she would not return from.

id: One of the sacred Guardians of Meirith. While out on a mission, she received word of some heretics who planned to defy Karna Masta, and decided to return immediately. This choice would mean leaving her friend Quaid behind in the territory they had been exploring, but according to legend, Claire chose to go with her brother in the end. Once she had returned to the Holy Emperor's side, she faced off against a group of bladed warriors, ultimately falling in battle as she tried to protect her brother. Too weakened by the wounds she had received during her previous mission to recover, she left her last words to her beloved brother.

id: Wanita jago pedang dari Kerajaan Sama yang hancur, dia akhirnya menjadi salah satu dari Enam Pahlawan. Dilahirkan dari keturunan pemimpin orang laut Savat, dia dibesarkan dengan teknik pedang panjang yang tradisional. Dia sangat menonjol sehingga dia ditawari pedang pusaka Lexida sebagai bukti kepemimpinannya pada usia 14. Dia menolaknya pada saat itu, mengklaim dirinya belum cukup pengalaman.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20011_DESCRIPTION
desc: A swordswoman from the ruined Sama Kingdom, she later became one of the Six Heroes. Born from a line of chiefs of the wandering sea people of Savat, she was raised in traditional long sword techniques. She stood out so much that she was offered the treasured sword Lexida as proof of her chiefdom at age 14. She refused it at the time, claiming she was inexperienced.

raw.en: A swordswoman from the ruined Sama Kingdom, she later became one of the Six Heroes. Born from a line of chiefs of the wandering sea people of Savat, she was raised in traditional long sword techniques. She stood out so much that she was offered the treasured sword Lexida as proof of her chiefdom at age 14. She refused it at the time, claiming she was inexperienced.
raw.es: Espadachina del antiguo reino de Sama, quien se convirtió en uno de los Seis Héroes. Selena es hija del jefe del clan marino de Savat y fue instruida en el arte de la espada larga. Sus dotes le valieron para que con solo 14 años le ofrecieran convertirse en líder de su clan y portar la preciada espada Lexida. La joven rechazó la oferta alegando que le faltaba experiencia.
raw.id: Wanita jago pedang dari Kerajaan Sama yang hancur, dia akhirnya menjadi salah satu dari Enam Pahlawan. Dilahirkan dari keturunan pemimpin orang laut Savat, dia dibesarkan dengan teknik pedang panjang yang tradisional. Dia sangat menonjol sehingga dia ditawari pedang pusaka Lexida sebagai bukti kepemimpinannya pada usia 14. Dia menolaknya pada saat itu, mengklaim dirinya belum cukup pengalaman.
raw.pt: Uma espadachim do Reino arruinado de Sama, que mais tarde se tornou uma dos Seis Heróis. Nascida de uma linhagem de chefes do povo dos errantes marítimos de Savat, ela foi treinada nas técnicas tradicionais da espada longa. Ela se destacou tanto que foi ofertada a cobiçada espada Lexida como prova de seu potencial como chefe aos 14 anos. Ela recusou na época, dizendo que era inexperiente.
raw.th: นักดาบหญิงจากราชอาณาจักรซามะที่ล่มสลาย หลังจากนั้นเธอก็กลายเป็นหนึ่งในหกวีรบุรุษ เป็นเฃื้อสายของหัวหน้าคนเร่รอนในทะเลแห่งซาวัท เธอได้รับการปลูกฝังเทคนิคดาบยาวมาในแบบดั้งเดิม เธอโดดเด่นมากจนเธอถูกเสนอให้ครองดาบล้ำค่า "เล็คส์สิดา" ซึ่งเป็นหลักฐานแห่งความเป็นหัวหน้าเผ่าของเธอที่เมื่ออายุได้ 14 ในตอนนั้นเธอได้ปฏิเสธโดยอ้างว่าเธอยังไร้ประสบการณ์
raw.vi: Một kiếm sĩ tới từ vương quốc Sama đổ nát, sau đó cô trở thành một trong sáu vị anh hùng. Sinh ra trong dòng tộc lãnh đạo dân biển lang thang của Savat, cô lớn lên với khả năng sử dụng thanh kiếm dài truyền thống. Cô rất nổi bật đến nỗi được trao thanh kiếm quý Lexida làm tín vật của lãnh đạo khi cô 14 tuổi. Vào thời điểm đó, cô từ chối và tuyên bố rằng cô chưa có đủ kinh nghiệm.

id: Wanita jago pedang dari Kerajaan Sama yang hancur, dia akhirnya menjadi salah satu dari Enam Pahlawan. Pada usia 18, dia akhirnya mengalah dan mengambil pedang pusaka Lexia sebagai bukti kepemimpinannya. Dia selalu menolak pedang itu, tapi pedang itu sangat cocok untuk gayanya yang cepat dan dingin seperti es. Mereka yang melawannya berkata mereka merasakan dingin yang membeku sebelum perang.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20012_DESCRIPTION
desc: A swordswoman from the ruined Sama Kingdom, she later became one of the Six Heroes. At 18, she folded to the pressure around her and took up the treasured sword Lexida as proof of her chiefdom. She had always rejected the sword, but it was a good fit for her quick and ice cold style. Those who faced her are said to have felt a freezing cold before battle.

raw.en: A swordswoman from the ruined Sama Kingdom, she later became one of the Six Heroes. At 18, she folded to the pressure around her and took up the treasured sword Lexida as proof of her chiefdom. She had always rejected the sword, but it was a good fit for her quick and ice cold style. Those who faced her are said to have felt a freezing cold before battle.
raw.es: Espadachina del antiguo reino de Sama, quien se convirtió en uno de los Seis Héroes. A los 18 años cedió ante la presión que la rodeaba y tomó la espada Lexida para hacerse líder del clan. Enseguida empezó a tener soltura con su nueva arma, que la hizo más fría y veloz de lo que ya era. Muchos de sus rivales dicen haber sentido un escalofrío antes de luchar contra ella.
raw.id: Wanita jago pedang dari Kerajaan Sama yang hancur, dia akhirnya menjadi salah satu dari Enam Pahlawan. Pada usia 18, dia akhirnya mengalah dan mengambil pedang pusaka Lexia sebagai bukti kepemimpinannya. Dia selalu menolak pedang itu, tapi pedang itu sangat cocok untuk gayanya yang cepat dan dingin seperti es. Mereka yang melawannya berkata mereka merasakan dingin yang membeku sebelum perang.
raw.pt: Uma espadachim do Reino arruinado de Sama, que mais tarde se tornou uma dos Seis Heróis. Aos 18, ela cedeu à pressão e aceitou a espada Lexida como sua coroação como chefe. Ela sempre rejeitou a espada, mas ela era uma boa combinação com seu estilo frio e rápido. Aqueles que a enfrentaram dizem ter sentido um frio congelante antes da batalha.
raw.th: นักดาบหญิงจากราชอาณาจักรซามะที่ล่มสลาย หลังจากนั้นเธอก็กลายเป็นหนึ่งในหกวีรบุรุษ เมื่ออายุ 18 เธอรับแรงกดดันรอบตัวเธอและหยิบดาบล้ำค่าเล็คส์สิดาเป็นหลักฐานแห่งความเป็นหัวหน้าเผ่าของเธอ ก่อนหน้าเธอได้ปฏิเสธดาบเล่มนี้เสมอ แต่มันเป็นดาบที่เหมาะสำหรับรูปแบบรวดเร็วและเย็นน้ำแข็งของเธออย่างลงตัว ผู้ที่ต้องเผชิญหน้ากับของเธอจะกล่าวว่ามีความรู้สึกหนาวเย็นก่อนที่จะต่อสู้
raw.vi: Một kiếm sĩ tới từ vương quốc Sama đổ nát, sau này trở thành một trong sáu vị anh hùng. Khi 18 tuổi, cô xếp lại lực lượng xung quanh mình và lấy thanh kiếm quý Lexida tín vật của lãnh đạo. Cô đã luôn luôn từ chối thanh kiếm, nhưng nó rất thích hợp với phong cách nhanh chóng và lạnh như băng của cô. Người ta nói rằng những người đối mặt với cô cảm thấy không khí lạnh băng trước khi chiến đấu.

id: Wanita jago pedang dari Kerajaan Sama yang hancur, dia akhirnya menjadi salah satu dari Enam Pahlawan. Pada masa perang sipil di Kerajaan Sama, dia membantu raja dan sebagai pemimpin orang Savat, memimpin mereka menang dalam banyak perang. Raja memberinya gelar Gilles De Lava, yang artinya penyelamat kerajaan. Orang Savat sangat senang, tapi katanya dia selalu mencari alasan untuk berhenti.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20013_DESCRIPTION
desc: A swordswoman from the ruined Sama Kingdom, she later became one of the Six Heroes. During a civil war in the Sama Kingdom, she aided the king and as chief of the Savat people, led them to many military victories. The king granted her the title Gilles De Lava, meaning savior of the kingdom. The Savat were pleased, but i'ts rumored she was always looking for a reason to quit.

raw.en: A swordswoman from the ruined Sama Kingdom, she later became one of the Six Heroes. During a civil war in the Sama Kingdom, she aided the king and as chief of the Savat people, led them to many military victories. The king granted her the title Gilles De Lava, meaning savior of the kingdom. The Savat were pleased, but i'ts rumored she was always looking for a reason to quit.
raw.es: Espadachina del antiguo reino de Sama, quien se convirtió en uno de los Seis Héroes. Durante la guerra civil del reino de Sama, ayudó al rey y ganó múltiples batallas como líder del clan Savat. El rey le concedió el título de Gilles De Lava, que significa la salvadora del reino. Su clan la adoraba, pero se rumora que ella pensaba abandonarlo tarde o temprano.
raw.id: Wanita jago pedang dari Kerajaan Sama yang hancur, dia akhirnya menjadi salah satu dari Enam Pahlawan. Pada masa perang sipil di Kerajaan Sama, dia membantu raja dan sebagai pemimpin orang Savat, memimpin mereka menang dalam banyak perang. Raja memberinya gelar Gilles De Lava, yang artinya penyelamat kerajaan. Orang Savat sangat senang, tapi katanya dia selalu mencari alasan untuk berhenti.
raw.pt: Uma espadachim do Reino arruinado de Sama, que mais tarde se tornou uma dos Seis Heróis. Durante uma guerra civil no Reino de Sama, ela ajudou o rei e, como chefe do povo Savat, os levou a muitas vitórias militares. O rei a concedeu o título Gilles De Lava, que significa “aquela que salvou o reino”. Os Savat estavam satisfeitos, mas havia o boato de que ela estava sempre procurando por um motivo para desistir.
raw.th: นักดาบหญิงจากราชอาณาจักรซามะที่ล่มสลาย หลังจากนั้นเธอก็กลายเป็นหนึ่งในหกวีรบุรุษ ในช่วงสงครามกลางเมืองของราชอาณาจักรซามะ เธอช่วยเหลือกษัตริย์ในฐานะหัวหน้าของชาวซาวัทและนำพวกเขาไปสู่ชัยชนะทางทหารจำนวนมาก กษัตริย์ประทานสมญาให้แก่เธอว่า "กิลส์ เดอ ลาวา" แปลว่า "ผู้กอบกู้แห่งราชอาณาจักร" ชาวซาวัททั้งหลายต่างยินดี แต่ก็มีข่าวลือว่าเธอมักจะมองหาเหตุผลที่จะลาออก
raw.vi: Một kiếm sĩ tới từ vương quốc Sama đổ nát, sau đó cô trở thành một trong sáu vị anh hùng. Trong một cuộc nội chiến tại vương quốc Sama, cô hỗ trợ nhà vua và là người đứng đầu nhóm người Savat, dẫn họ đến nhiều chiến thắng quân sự. Vua cấp cho cô danh hiệu Gilles De Lava, có nghĩa là vị cứu tinh của vương quốc. Các Savat hài lòng, nhưng có tin đồn cô luôn luôn tìm kiếm lý do để bỏ đi.

id: Wanita jago pedang dari Kerajaan Sama yang hancur. Dia penyelamat kerajaan dan satu dari enam pahlawan. Dalam perang besar dia menolak panggilan kerajaan dan memimpin orang Savat untuk menyelamatkan rakyat. Menyesuaikan dengan keahliannya, Pedang Lexia menunjukkan kekuatan aslinya, memotong para dewa dengan pukulan biru pucat yang dingin. Dia memberi keberanian pada rakyatnya dan menakutkan bagi para dewa.
name: MST_UNITCOMMENT_20014_DESCRIPTION
desc: A swordswoman from the ruined Sama Kingdom. She is the savior of her kingdom, and one of the six heroes. During the great war she refused Sama Kingdom's call and led the Savat people to save the masses. Her sword, Lexida, showed its true power in response to her skill, cutting down the gods with a cold pale blue strike. She gave the people courage and terrified the gods.

raw.en: A swordswoman from the ruined Sama Kingdom. She is the savior of her kingdom, and one of the six heroes. During the great war she refused Sama Kingdom's call and led the Savat people to save the masses. Her sword, Lexida, showed its true power in response to her skill, cutting down the gods with a cold pale blue strike. She gave the people courage and terrified the gods.
raw.es: Salvadora del antiguo reino de Sama y posterior miembro de los Seis Héroes. Durante la gran guerra, se negó a auxiliar al reino de Sama y alentó a su clan a proteger a los más inocentes. Su espada Lexida mostró todo su poder en respuesta a su talento y asestó un gélido golpe a los dioses, lo que animó a muchos a unirse a la guerra.
raw.id: Wanita jago pedang dari Kerajaan Sama yang hancur. Dia penyelamat kerajaan dan satu dari enam pahlawan. Dalam perang besar dia menolak panggilan kerajaan dan memimpin orang Savat untuk menyelamatkan rakyat. Menyesuaikan dengan keahliannya, Pedang Lexia menunjukkan kekuatan aslinya, memotong para dewa dengan pukulan biru pucat yang dingin. Dia memberi keberanian pada rakyatnya dan menakutkan bagi para dewa.
raw.pt: Uma espadachim do Reino arruinado de Sama, que mais tarde se tornou uma dos Seis Heróis. Ela foi a salvadora de seu reino, e uma dos Seis Heróis. Duirante a guerra ela rejeitou o chamado do Reino de Sama e liderou o povo Savat para salvar as massas. Sua espada, Lexida, mostrou seu verdadeiro poder em resposta à sua habilidade, abatendo os deuses com um frio golpe azul-pálido. Ela deu coragem às pessoas e aterrorizou os deuses.
raw.th: นักดาบหญิงจากราชอาณาจักรซามะที่ล่มสลาย เธอเป็นผู้กอบกู้แห่งราชอาณาจักรและหนึ่งในหกวีรบุรุษ ในช่วงสงครามใหญ่เธอปฏิเสธการเรียกตัวของราชอาณาจักรซามะและนำชาวซาวัทเข้าช่วยเหลือมวลชน ดาบของเธอเล็คส์สิดาแสดงแสนยานุภาพที่แท้จริงตอบสนองความสามารถของเธอ มันตัดเหล่าเทพด้วยคมดาบเย็นสีฟ้าซีด เธอมอบความกล้าหาญให้กับผู้คนและเขย่าขวัญเหล่าเทพ
raw.vi: Một kiếm sĩ tới từ vương quốc Sama đổ nát. Cô là vị cứu tinh của cả vương quốc, và là một trong sáu vị anh hùng. Trong cuộc chiến tranh lớn cô từ chối lời kêu gọi của vương quốc Sama mà lãnh đạo nhân dân Savat để cứu lấy quần chúng. Thanh kiếm Lexida bộc lộ sức mạnh thực sự của nó để đáp ứng với kỹ năng của cô, hạ gục các vị thần bằng một nhát chém lạnh màu xanh nhạt. Cô truyền cho mọi người sự can đảm và khiến các vị thần khiếp sợ.
